message.content: According to the conversations recorded, Li Hua expressed enthusiasm about the upcoming updates in "Call of Duty: Warzone". Specifically, during a discussion about the game, Li Hua stated, "Absolutely! I'm always up for something new in the game. I love exploring fresh content and teaming up with friends!" Furthermore, Li Hua mentioned looking forward to "hoping to dive back in when they drop [the updates]", indicating her intention to play "Warzone" once the updates are released.
